correctness.rationale: The renewal equation and its two transforms are derived with all normalizations, including reset-interval atoms and defective waiting laws. Identical ±1-jump spatial marginals determine count generating functions on a real interval. Equality of iid-renewal and reset-aged transforms forces 1/F affine on overlapping length-λ intervals; sF(s)→1 and F(s)≤1/s imply F(s)=1/(s+r). Laplace uniqueness establishes exponential survival and the unique waiting law. Explicit generator and transform tests (207) reproduce finite instances, not infinite proofs. Covariance and regenerative time-average witnesses are proved analytically.

value.rationale: It supplies a sharp structural and observational identifiability boundary for promoting a general reset-CTRW one-time mixture to a genuine iid-wait CTRW: only memoryless resets permit that, then only via a defective waiting law. The physically motivated time-correlation and time-average witness quantifies why the marginal surrogate is not an adequate dynamic model. The theorem is all-reset-law, not a routine isolated numeric example.
